reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: Ni3Ti precipitation strengthening is well-established in Ni-based superalloys, and applying it to a Ti-Ni-rich high-entropy alloy matrix is a logical extension, though the exact aging parameters and precipitate morphology in this novel matrix are uncertain.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and decisive: a direct comparison of aged vs. solutionized samples via high-temperature tensile/creep tests, with a quantitative falsification criterion (≥10% improvement) and microstructural confirmation.
reasons.usefulness: This is a highly useful, directly actionable hypothesis that addresses the core question of improving elevated-temperature performance in an unexplored alloy class, providing a clear experimental path.
